'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Steve Harpster LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / I Will Bring The Senate Together|Plead My Case To The Senate / I Will Bring The Senate Together (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
